clips.title: The story
paras: The Fang of Vagash is a massive predator tooth taken from the notorious beast Vagash in the snowy crags of Dun Morogh. It serves as tangible proof for local breeders that the marauding monster threatening their prized rams has finally been slain.

Dun Morogh's high crags are home to bitter cold and ferocious predators, but none have plagued the local ranches quite like Vagash. Looming in the ridges above the Amberstill Ranch, this savage beast frequently stalks downhill under cover of darkness to slaughter prized rams. With Ironforge's troops already stretched thin, the local herdsmen cannot count on the city guard for protection. Slaying the beast and carving away one of its vicious fangs offers indisputable evidence that the pasturelands are safe once more.
